years.retained_earnings_note: Retained earnings for Thomas Cook uses total shareholders' equity as a proxy -- the actual retained-earnings sub-line wasn't separately extractable. This makes the Altman Z''-Score slightly OPTIMISTIC relative to the true figure, since total equity also includes share capital, share premium and other reserves and so typically exceeds retained earnings. Disclosed here as a limitation, not corrected silently.
years.source: [GBP] https://www.annualreports.com/HostedData/AnnualReportArchive/t/LSE_TCG_2016.pdf | Group income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, AR&A FY2016 (year ended 30 Sept 2016). EBIT = total Profit from operations (incl. separately disclosed items) = 205. Total Debt = Borrowings only (current 891 + non-current 847) = 1738; EXCLUDES finance lease obligations (current 42 + non-current 141 = 183) for consistency with Carillion single-line borrowing treatment -- revisit if leases should be included uniformly across all companies. Receivables = current trade and other receivables only (688); excludes non-current receivables (58). RED FLAG: Total liabilities (6,564) vs net assets of just 391 -- very thin equity cushion. Current liabilities (4,630) far exceed current assets (2,656), current ratio well under 1.

years.source: [GBP] https://www.annualreports.com/HostedData/AnnualReportArchive/t/LSE_TCG_2017_e438c6e1e74f4d3ca3946ad79d787c98.pdf | Group income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, AR&A FY2017 (year ended 30 Sept 2017). EBIT = total Profit from operations (incl. separately disclosed items) = 231. Net Income = attributable to equity holders of parent = 13 (total incl. NCI was 12). Current Assets includes 101 of non-current assets held for sale, treated as current since expected sale <12mo -- flag if reviewer prefers strict balance-sheet-line treatment (would be 2,241 excl.). Total Debt = Borrowings only (current 245 + non-current 1,047) = 1,292; excludes finance lease obligations (39+115=154) for consistency with 2016 treatment. Receivables = current only (735), excl. non-current (65). RED FLAG: current ratio ~0.54 (worse than FY16), net assets fell from 326 to 280 -- shrinking equity cushion two years running.

years.source: [GBP] https://www.annualreports.com/HostedData/AnnualReports/PDF/LSE_TCG_2018.pdf | Group income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement, AR&A FY2018 (year ended 30 Sept 2018). EBIT = total Profit from operations (incl. separately disclosed items) = 97. Net Income = attributable to equity holders of parent = (163) loss. Current Assets includes 55 of non-current assets held for sale (consistent treatment with FY2017). Total Debt = Borrowings only (current 184 + non-current 1,028) = 1,212; excludes finance lease obligations (34+182=216) for consistency. Receivables = current only (811). RED FLAG: EBIT fell from 231 (FY17) to 97 (FY18); swung from 13 profit to 163 loss; OCF fell from 496 to 139 (-72%) despite revenue still growing (9,007 -> 9,584). Profitability and cash generation deteriorated sharply a full year before the Sept 2019 collapse while revenue looked healthy -- good example of why revenue alone is a poor distress signal.
